Package org.yuemi.libs.api.folia

Interface FoliaScheduler

All Known Implementing Classes:
FoliaSchedulerImpl
public interface FoliaScheduler
Cross-platform scheduler interface that works on both Paper and Folia.

On Folia, tasks are routed to the correct region thread automatically. On Paper, they execute on the server thread with equivalent semantics.
